extracted.name: Carrots with bacon & marmalade butter
extracted.description: Take the humble carrot to new heights with an irresistible bacon and marmalade butter. This makes a great Christmas dinner side
ingredient_lines: 800g carrots halved down the centre and sliced on an angle
instruction_lines: Heat the grill to high and grill the bacon for 3-4 mins each side until crisp. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Chop the bacon as finely as you can and combine well with the butter and marmalade. Will keep chilled for up to three days.

Put the carrots in a pan and cover with boiling water. Boil for 5-6 mins until cooked but retaining some bite, then drain and tip into a bowl. Put slices of the butter on top, tossing until the butter has melted.
